events.verdict: Mobley (CLE) maintains verticality as he defends Siakam's (IND) shot attempt.
Allen (CLE) initiates contact with Furphy (IND) that affects his ability to secure the rebound.
Potter (IND) establishes himself in Porter Jr.'s (CLE) path prior to the contact.
Siakam (IND) maintains verticality as he defends Garland's (CLE) shot attempt.
Furphy (IND) establishes himself in Mobley's (CLE) path prior to the contact.
Garland (CLE) does not establish a legal guarding position in Siakam's (IND) path prior to the contact.
Furphy (IND) applies his hand to Garland's (CLE) upper body, and the contact is marginal.  Garland loses his balance on his own and falls to the floor on his own accord.
Mobley (CLE) steps out of bounds while he is in possession of the ball.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Pacers.
Porter Jr. (CLE) moves into Siakam's (IND) path and delivers body to body contact as he defends the shot attempt.
Nembhard (IND) hooks his arm around Allen's (CLE) leg as he attempts to disengage following the expiration of the pick, and the contact affects Allen's FOM.
Nembhard (IND) legally contests Garland's (CLE) jump shot attempt.
Nembhard (IND) does not inbound the ball within five seconds.
Mobley (CLE) establishes positive frontcourt position and then passes the ball back into the backcourt without the ball being deflected by a defender.
Merrill (CLE) commits a take foul on Nembhard (IND).
Nembhard (IND) commits a take foul on Porter Jr. (CLE).
Mobley (CLE) commits a take foul on Nesmith (IND).  The contact occurs prior to the start of Nesmith's upward shooting motion, and a non-shooting foul is correctly called.
Huff (IND) commits a take foul on Allen (CLE).
